notes.title: Hello the new work of 火鸡头Studio, "Obi 3011", is now availableon Steam.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915368/536f7145916f54aed4d8605965f22217334c6e06.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003880/3011/?beta=1
this game name is《obi3011》.
This is an Amare-themed, cyberpunk-backgrounded pixelated romantic adventure text game. It starts with a chance encounter in the rain, followed by an inevitable cohabitation, leading to a series of misadventures. As a robot, your hilarious romantic adventure with your furry companions unfolds from there.

In the game, you play as an isolated, homebody, and alcoholic robot who collapses on the street after another excessive drinking session, only to be rescued by an unidentified dog-like furry creature and taken back to your own home.

However, through a series of coincidences, he suddenly loses his memory!

During this process, you must coexist with him in your home and embark on an adventure with him and other companions to search for his memories!

Of course, adventure in this tumultuous era is extremely dangerous. As you make progress in restoring his memories, your bond grows stronger, and at the same time, some unknown secrets gradually surface, as if everything is slowly changing...

Faced with these harsh realities, can you make the right choices to ensure that he remains the same person, and that your relationship remains unchanged?

-Game Features-
■ The game's storyline focuses on sweet and hilarious adventure-filled daily routines. If you have a particular fondness for furries, younger partners, shotas, humanoids, robots, romance, humor, adventure, cyberpunk, pixels, psychological horror, and other such elements, then please do give this game a try!
■ Outstanding gameplay performances, exquisite pixelated CGs, UIs, and backgrounds, with many visual effects animated!
■ Take care of a cute and clingy little dog, embark on an adventure with him, and experience a sweet romance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915368/614a2ee952f1ef920ef2b17b2a4e4603a50df9ba.gif[/img]

If you're interested, please help me by adding this game to your wishlist! 🙏 Thank you!

notes.title: 游戏闪退问题Regarding the issue of game crashesゲームのフラッシュバック問題に対して
notes.content:
the issue of game crashes, we initially determined that it was due to the poor optimization of the game, as well as the excessive memory usage of the scenes and animations, leading to crashes for some players.
We have optimized the game's memory usage and streamlined most animations, CGs, and music.
Now, the game's memory usage has been reduced from around 460MB to about 360MB.
As a low-resolution game, we apologize for not handling the optimization issue properly in the past, and for not addressing it promptly due to my busy academic schedule. We are glad to announce that the optimization has now been successfully implemented, and we hope it can resolve the crashing issue for some players.
If you encounter any further issues or bugs, please feel free to leave your feedback in this post or the comment section.
In addition, the Mac version is still under development.
Thank you for playing our game! ❤
